title: Virtue
subtitle: A faithful keeper of all your secrets. The hand of fate closest to the living.

items.text: The commander's furious shouting snaps Marguerite back to reality.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: She's back.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: You again, Larisa?

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: It's one problem after another with you!

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: I-I didn't—
Before she can say anything, the commander grabs her subordinate by the front of her shirt.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: How many times do I have to tell you? You're a Hush Trooper. This is no place for a softy.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Who do you think you are, huh? A hero fighting against authority? A savior to these people?

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Even if you save their lives here, they'll probably end up dead where they're going.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: All you've done is delayed the mission. You want to be kicked out of Zeno and left to the "Storm"?

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Is that what you want? To get the whole squad killed to feed your ego?

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: Y-You knew all along. They aren't really deserters.
Larisa's voice trembles as she dares to speak the words.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: That's what we've been doing all this time?

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: Sending innocent arcanists to their deaths one after another.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: So what?
Their commander's reply is as stark and biting as the wind lashing their faces.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Even more will die if we can't figure out how to stop the "Storm."

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Ugh, I'm wasting my time talking to the both of you.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Once this mission is over, I'm filing a request to have you removed from my squad. As for where you'll end up, or whether Zeno will even keep you, I don't give a damn.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: You-You can't do this.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Why not? Without Zeno's shelter, there's nothing you can do against the "Storm."
Then the commander turns to Marguerite. She's leaning against the truck without emotion. In that moment, it seems as if their conflict does not concern her in the slightest.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: And you, Marguerite!

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: You think staying silent will get you off the hook? I know you're the one who unlocked the door for her.
She lunges for Marguerite's collar in the same way, but the young woman twists out of the way and catches her commander's wrist.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: You're wrong.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: What? L-Let go of me! What do you think you're doing?

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Argh!
The commander falls to the ground with a sharp cry.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: What is going on, Marguerite? Have you lost your mind?

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: You'll face a military tribunal for attacking our commander, especially at a time like this.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Hush Squad's number-one rule: "No communication with mission targets." That's what she said.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: Huh?

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: I just wanted to tell her she was wrong.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: If you really want to play with life and death, you need to get inside the target's head, know how they think and move. That's how you assert control.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: That's the best part.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: This is no time for jokes, Marguerite.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Let me show you. Our dear commander here always keeps a bullet tucked in her sleeve.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Ever since the war in 1999, she's carried it around as a little "lucky charm."
Marguerite pulls a bullet from her sleeve, revealing it purposefully to the frightened commander at her feet.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: As expected.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: So you know the commander's secret. What does it matter? She isn't your target, is she?

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: You're right. She's not my target.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: Th-Then why did you ...
She loads the round into a pistol and pulls back the slide.
Then she turns to place the gun in Larisa's hand. The terrified girl is forced to level the weapon at their commander's head.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: She's yours, Larisa.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: M-Mine?

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: Marguerite, this is wrong. We-We can't do this. I can't do this.

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: You're insane, both of you! Put the gun down, and let me go.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Think, Larisa. Why should you let her go?

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: She'll report everything you did. They'll make sure you quietly disappear in the "Storm."

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: You don't really care what happens to you, I know.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: But think about those poor kidnapped "deserters." They're just innocent arcanists, some of them children.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: They'll be sent to that lab, subjected to torture you can't even imagine, unless you do something now.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: You've known this all along. It's time you faced it.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: You're right. I-I have to face it.

items.speaker: Hush Trooper
items.text: I have to ...

items.speaker: Hush Squad Commander
items.text: Larisa, don't!
The crack of the pistol dies against the swirling winds. Snow already covering the evidence of what had just occurred—scattered footprints and a body oozing life into the cold permafrost.
Marguerite looks into her commander's fading eyes as they take on a deathly gloss. The snow is already settling on her frozen skin, burying the last moment of terror still written on her face.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: I like that look on your face. It suits you.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Drako   Drought.
Arcane fire burns away every trace of what transpired there, even the transport truck marked with Zeno symbols.

She looks out over the snowy expanse. She can still just about spot the many footprints leading away from the scene. Whether Larisa and her liberated "deserters" will survive their trek is a mystery even she hasn't calculated to its end.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Time to run, dear. Follow that dark mix of kindness and viciousness in your heart straight into the quagmire.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: I look forward to seeing you fully submerged in it in the future.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Well, I suppose that wraps up my days in Zeno, boring as they were, besides the death.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Where to next? Maybe back to Cambridge?

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: One day, I'll figure out what Zeno, and a certain white house behind it, is really up to.
She turns away, walking alone into the icy wilderness.
